setup: npm install, and a checkout of ReceiptPrinterPlayground next to this repository, RENDERER_PLAYGROUND overrides the path, see tools/external/playground/capture.js
notes: The images sample of the playground's "New..." menu, section 16g. The 128 by 128 logo of the playground, dithered with Atkinson and centred. Evaluated the way src/utils/encoder.js of the playground does, in an async function with an `encoder` of 32 columns and a `model` of 'Generic', which is what the playground puts there when no printer model is selected, and with an `Image` that reads the data URI of the sample with the PNG reader of the contact sheet instead of a canvas, see tools/external/playground/capture.js. Reviewed as ASCII art against the render of the other language of the same width.
